items.headline: DOE transfers HALEU title to Centrus unit ACO under new agreement
items.what_happened: On October 20, 2026, Centrus signed a HALEU Transfer Agreement with DOE. Under it, DOE conveyed to American Centrifuge Operating (ACO), a Centrus subsidiary, title to certain HALEU, low-enriched uranium feed and heels, depleted tails and cylinders made or bought under the HALEU Operation Contract. ACO took on facility costs, security and environmental compliance for those materials and agreed to hold the HALEU for resale to DOE on request.
items.why_it_matters: The HALEU moves into a Centrus subsidiary, but it is held for resale to DOE on request. It is not a commercial supply contract, so it does not by itself open HALEU to 1-20 MW reactor developers.
items.binding_note: Signed agreement, as described in Centrus's Q3 2026 Form 10-Q. The agreement text was not retrieved, so terms come from the filing's description.
